summary: Ran 10 pytest backend tests (all passed) plus a Playwright end-to-end smoke covering the four new/changed areas: JSON-error resilience, legacy watchlist self-heal, live Yahoo News, custom NSE ticker (PAYTM), and Sector Deep Dive (Technology + FMCG empty). Every scenario passed.

integration_issues.issue: When /api/stocks/{symbol} returns 503 (e.g. bogus symbol) the toast fires (readable message, no JSON parse error) but the StockDetail page stays stuck on 'Loading stock detail…' indefinitely. Consider rendering an error/empty state with a back button.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In StockDetail, capture the fetch error into local state and render a proper empty state (currently only a toast fires while the page stays on the 'Loading…' spinner).
OPTIONAL: sector-empty currently reuses the .loading class; consider a dedicated empty-state style/back-link (a back-sector-button is already provided).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sector_detail: `matching and meta[matching[0]]['sector'] or name` — the `matching` guard is dead code because a 404 has already been raised when matching is empty; leave as-is but simplify to `meta[matching[0]]['sector']`.
App.js: after add/remove stock the drawer calls window.location.reload() which is heavy — refetching /api/dashboard via state would be smoother, but not a functional bug.
server.py add_stock relies on `stocks_meta` cache but never re-verifies stale entries; low priority.
test_credentials: Fresh users are registered on the fly (watchit.<uuid>@example.com / watchit123). No pre-provisioned account required.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test users during pytest run and one UI test user (watchit.ui.<hex>@example.com). One legacy watchlist doc was inserted directly into Mongo (no watchlist_id) to prove the /api/dashboard self-heal path — the doc was healed by the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Yahoo News feed with real hrefs/relative times, custom NSE tickers via yfinance resolve, sector deep dive with leaders/laggards/constituents/empty-state, parseError toast for non-JSON error bodies) verified end-to-end. Regression flows (register/login/logout, dashboard live=6/6, watchlists CRUD, attention reasons) all green. The only non-blocker: StockDetail component doesn't render an inline error state on 503 — it stays on the loading spinner while a toast is shown; main agent may want to polish this.
rca of the issue: Not applicable this iteration — no bugs were reproduced. The prior JSON-parse bug is fully mitigated (parseError helper in App.js handles non-JSON error bodies and legacy watchlist docs are self-healed both on startup and inside ensure_default_watchlist).
